text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora suffered a major injury
during training, so she was immediately
treated at the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ngh~~!
Th-This might actually be pretty serious...
choice_data_list: Nothing for it, let's focus on getting you properly healed.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Hrmm.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should deliberately go for training here?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Nah, I feel like once things get so bad they hit rock bottom, you can totally push through!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's asking for the near-impossible. But knowing
Fusaichi Pandora, she just might pull it off.
In this situation—
choice_data_list: No, you really need to rest here.
No, you should get some proper rest here.
...Just make sure you don't overdo it.
...Just make sure you don't overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's asking for the near-impossible. But knowing
Fusaichi Pandora, she just might pull it off.
In this situation—
choice_data_list: No, you really need to rest here.
No, you should get some proper rest here.
...Just make sure you don't overdo it.
...Just make sure you don't overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehh, aren't you worrying a bit too much?
choice_data_list: It'll be too late once something happens.
It'll be too late once something happens.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, you're actually serious.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright~
If Trainer says so, I'll take a break~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: But still, but still, think of something fun to pass the time instead, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Alright, countin' on ya~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"You get it, don'tcha~? ♡
Well, just you watch and see~♪"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah! That hurts—!
No way, no way, absolutely not happening!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hold meee~ Carry me, Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, Fusaichi Pandora's injury became even more severe, and she spent her time resting quietly until it fully healed...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ooh, look at you go!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Fufun♪ As expected of me!
choice_data_list: Yeah. But let's call it a day for now.
Yeah. But let's call it a day for now.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, well, yeah.
Getting hurt like that plain sucks anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Continuing with light, sensible training, Fusaichi Pandora made a smooth return to the track.
